hypothesis_description: v5 cycle G1 paradigm-inviable scoped 후 — 약세 예측 자체 fail은 paradigm 한계가 아닌 **실험 설계 부실**에서 비롯됨 (도훈 reframe 정합). 핵심 변경 5축: (1) **Dedicated features 신규 구축** — Estrella-Hardouvelis 1991 yield curve + Stock-Watson 2003 leading indicators + Ang-Chen 2002 asymmetric cor + Engle-Mistry 2014 vol regime + Adrian-Brunnermeier 2016 CoVaR + Frazzini-Pedersen 2014 BAB bear market 학술 backbone. (2) **Qvest 인프라 + 직접 수집** — Factor DB 일간 309 + FRED yield curve + ECOS KR macro + SEIBro ETF flow (Phase A 완료) + KRX foreign flow + VKOSPI + Credit spread. (3) **Multi-model ensemble** — LightGBM + LSTM (sequential) + Markov Switching (regime probability) + Logistic (interpretable baseline) + Random Forest (robustness). (4) **Daily-frequency** — monthly 124 → daily ~3000 obs (25x 증가). (5) **G1 5-subgate strict + Codex + Architect external verification**. 도훈 mandate '자율성 발휘' 정합 — 직접 데이터 수집 protocol design + 학술 backbone features 자율 구축. 병렬 WT_019_001 DPL_KR_v3 alpha와 별도 lifecycle.
